name: GC Biopharma Corp.
summary: GC Biopharma Corp., a biopharmaceutical company, develops and sells pharmaceutical drugs in South Korea and internationally. It provides over-the-counter drugs, such as Acustop Cataplasma for Analgesic and anti-inflammatory effect; and Kenhancer plaster for anti-inflammatory. The company also offers prescription drugs such as Hunterase ICV for treatment for hunter syndrome effect; Hunterase for treatment for hunter syndrome; vaccines include BARYCELA Inj. for prophylaxis of varicella; GC FLU Quadrivalent Pre-filled syringe inj. for prevention of influenza(flu); and GC FLU pre-filled syringe inj. for prevention of influenza(flu).
